persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.

messages.text: Could you make me a poster for a book swap? I’m helping with the swap and would feel better having a poster ready to share. What I need, somewhere in all my explaining, is one square poster image with black lettering only. The text should be exactly 'BOOK SWAP', 'Saturday 10-2' and 'Maple Hall', with no additional wording. There should be no pictures or illustrations, just the type in a straightforward, readable poster layout. The background colour is your call.
